citations.A1: Cache is populated once and never invalidated — fix by checking file mtime/hash each call and reloading when it changes
citations.A2: Tempting fix "just clear `_cache` on a timer" doesn't work — a poll interval still serves stale data between ticks
citations.A3: it fixes cross-call staleness only by removing caching, defeating the point without addressing invalidation
citations.A4: `path` is ignored after first call — a second call with a different path silently returns the first path's cached config; fix by keying the cache on path
citations.A5: Global mutable `_cache` isn't thread-safe — concurrent reload should use a lock if this runs multi-threaded
